mapper.select: SELECT c.pcid,c.pcname,COUNT(p.pid) AS count FROM pclist c LEFT JOIN pwork p ON p.pcid=c.pcid AND p.wstatus='展示' GROUP BY c.pcid,c.pcname,c.sort ORDER BY c.sort ASC,c.pcid ASC
SELECT pcid FROM pclist ORDER BY pcid FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pclist WHERE BINARY pcname = BINARY #{pcname}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pclist (pcid,pcname,cds,sort) SELECT #{pcid},#{pcname},#{cds,jdbcType=VARCHAR},COALESCE(MAX(sort),0)+10 FROM pclist
mapper.select: SELECT sort FROM pclist WHERE pcid=#{pcid}
